criteria.scenario: A consumer builds and invokes the goreadable command against a Go package.
criteria.oracle: The command exits zero and reports the over-threshold function and struct as review candidates.

criteria.scenario: A consumer uses the published Go module identity.
criteria.oracle: The module identity is github.com/goropikari/goreadable and the CLI build target is ./cmd/goreadable.

criteria.scenario: A consumer requests JSON for AI review.
criteria.oracle: JSON has schema version 1 and each candidate includes kind, name, path, line range, code classification, metrics, thresholds, and reasons, but not source context.

criteria.scenario: A consumer uses the default text report.
criteria.oracle: Text output identifies the candidate, its source location, and the threshold rule that selected it.

criteria.scenario: A consumer configures thresholds in a repository file and overrides them for one invocation.
criteria.oracle: goreadable.json changes the threshold, and a corresponding CLI flag takes precedence over that file.

criteria.scenario: A consumer reviews only changes since a Git ref.
criteria.oracle: --diff HEAD reports a candidate introduced after HEAD and does not report unchanged over-threshold code.

criteria.scenario: A consumer receives candidates or provides invalid CLI input.
criteria.oracle: Candidates do not fail the command; invalid options fail it and describe the problem on standard error.
